description: This is an integration test class for a Spring Boot application, testing SAML login/logout and metadata endpoints using HtmlUnit and MockMvc.

classes.name: SamlExtensionUrlsApplicationITests
classes.description: Integration test class for SAML-related endpoints in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes WebClient cookies before each test.

methods.name: authenticationAttemptWhenValidThenShowsUserEmailAddress
methods.description: Tests successful login displays user's email address.

methods.name: logoutWhenRelyingPartyInitiatedLogoutThenLoginPageWithLogoutParam
methods.description: Tests logout process redirects to login with logout parameter.

methods.name: metadataWhenGetThenForwardToUrl
methods.description: Tests that GET request to /saml/metadata forwards to /saml2/metadata.

methods.name: performLogin
methods.description: Performs login by filling form and submitting.

methods.name: findForm
methods.description: Finds the login form with name 'f' in the page.
